##### Project general facts

Mariane Tower by Gisaura Group is a striking contemporary high-rise located in the heart of Dubai Marina, designed as a true architectural landmark. Rising 38 floors, the tower offers a diverse mix of residences including elegant apartments and exclusive duplex units, along with retail spaces and offices. Its modern façade and intelligent design approach integrate advanced AI-driven systems, enhancing both functionality and the overall living experience. With its impressive scale and refined vertical composition, the tower embodies the essence of modern urban luxury living.

The development offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, sophistication, and breathtaking surroundings. Residents enjoy panoramic views of Dubai Marina, the Emirates Golf Club, and the Arabian Gulf, creating a constant sense of openness and prestige. A curated selection of amenities and services ensures comfort and ease in daily life, while the tower’s prime Marina location provides immediate access to world-class dining, retail, leisure, and entertainment options, all within minutes from home.

Inside, Mariane Tower features modern finishing with high-quality materials, designed to create bright and elegant living spaces. Floor-to-ceiling windows maximise natural light and frame the stunning views, while smart home integration adds a layer of convenience and control. Kitchens are equipped with built-in appliances, offering a practical yet refined cooking environment. The project is delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise each space according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Marina is an iconic and prestigious waterfront community situated along the shoreline of Dubai. As one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods, it offers a captivating blend of urban sophistication, leisure, and breathtaking views. The centerpiece of Dubai Marina is the man-made canal, which stretches over three kilometers and is surrounded by a collection of stunning high-rise buildings and luxurious waterfront residences. This vibrant development is known for its modern architecture and impressive skyline, making it a distinctive landmark in the city.

Living there offers residents a lifestyle of convenience and luxury. The community is home to a wide range of amenities, including world-class restaurants, upscale shopping malls, and trendy cafes. The iconic Marina Walk provides a delightful promenade for leisurely strolls, with various dining and entertainment options overlooking the tranquil waters.

The Dubai Marina Yacht Club further adds to the community's allure, attracting yacht enthusiasts and offering a picturesque setting for waterfront leisure and events. The marina's prime location ensures easy access to the Arabian Gulf, providing residents with the opportunity to enjoy water sports, yachting, and other maritime activities.

Dubai Marina is strategically connected to other parts of the city through its efficient transportation network, including the Dubai Metro and major highways. Its proximity to major business districts, entertainment centers, and renowned landmarks make it a preferred choice for residents and visitors alike.
